name: Universal Partners Ltd.
source: Yahoo Finance chart API (OHLC split-adjusted, not dividend-adjusted)
basis_note: Split-adjusted: past bars are adjusted for splits only, NOT for dividends. This is TradingView's default chart basis (its 'Adjust data for dividends' option is off by default).

flat_marks.rule: a flat bar (o=h=l=c) with volume 0 is the exchange's carried close for a session that did not trade; it is marked halt=true and v=0, never rescaled. This marker is metadata only - no price changes.

scale_fixed_note: Unit-standardised: 16 bar(s) multiplied by the exact integer factor TradingView's own JSE series proves on a nearby date (4 bar(s) confirmed directly, 12 completed across the same contiguous run). No bar added, removed or reordered; every bar still satisfies low<=open<=high and low<=close<=high.
